name: Rocket Blast - 1g Cart - Astro Sour
description:
Sharp, sour, and packed with flavor. The Rocket Blast Astro Sour cartridge holds 1 gram of premium distillate in a universal-fit 510-thread cart that screws right onto any standard battery — simple, reliable, and made to last.

Astro Sour delivers a bold, tangy punch: bright sour citrus up front with a sweet candy edge and a smooth finish that keeps every pull sharp and flavorful. It's a taste-forward pick for anyone who likes their sessions bright, zesty, and full of character.

Why you'll love it:

1G of premium distillate — smooth, potent, and consistent
Universal 510-thread fit — works with any standard 510 battery
Bold Astro Sour flavor — tangy sour citrus with a sweet candy edge
Reliable performance — flavorful, even pulls from first to last

Big flavor and dependable quality in a classic, easy-to-use cartridge. Just attach your battery and enjoy — Rocket Blast Astro Sour is ready when you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
